newsitem.title: USA: Transocean gets contracts for two in fleet.
newsitem.headline: Transocean gets contracts for two in fleet.

text.p: Transocean Offshore Inc said Thursday it received contract commitments on two of its semisubmersibles, the Treasure Legend and Transocean Driller.
The company said Amerada Hess Corp contracted the Treasure Legend for five years, and DuPont Co's Conoco Exploration and Production Nigeria Ltd contracted the Transocean Driller for 180 days.

The company said it estimates total revenues generated during the initial three years of the Treasure Legend contract will be $142 million. Revenues generated during the final two-years of the contract are subject to mutually agreed dayrates.
Total revenues generated during the 180 day Transocean Driller contract are expected to be $24 million.
The company said it expects the Treasure Legend contract will begin in January 1998.
